items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “I really want to record you.” I said, “I have a group now.” He said, okay, let’s go. That’s how we did Lookout Farm.

ctx.x: So he made you an offer.

The first year it was with Elvin, Berlin festival, ’72, ’71, whatever. “Hello, I’m Manfred Eicher. I’m ECM.” Just the very beginning. Just had a few records out. “Oh, thank you. I’d love to record.” Never heard from him. Next year, I was with Miles, Berlin Festival. He said, “I really want to record you.” I said, “I have a group now.” He said, okay, let’s go. That’s how we did Lookout Farm.
You did it with Richie and Tusa and Jeff, plus . . .
